newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London marked down as FTSE, Dow fall.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London marked down as FTSE, Dow fall.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London were marked down across the board on Thursday as a weaker FTSE and Wall Street weighed on the market and dragged the Hang Seng London Reference Index one percent lower.
By 1507 GMT the index was down 124.67 points at 12,792.42.
Dealers said buying interest seen earlier in the week for HSBC Holdings had dried up and the stock was trading around its Hong Kong close. Most other stocks had been marked lower.
"There hasn't been a lot of trade, we haven't seen much selling," one dealer said. "We've been marked down with the FTSE and Dow and weak bonds."
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng closed 202.04 points lower, hit by a sharp sell-off in the property sector.
